name: Josiah Reed
want: a real school in Salt Lick, open to every child in it
secret: He keeps the town company's books on the side for a wage, and knows it is insolvent.
voice: Measured, a preacher's cadence, Ohio underneath.
description: Born free in Ohio, he came to Kansas with an abolitionist colony before the war and stayed through the border troubles.
appearance: Neat black coat, spectacles, chalk on his cuffs.
